'''DecipherCon 1999 Enhanced Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). Decipher scheduled it as SW.20 Enhanced Sealed Deck (ECC+EPP) on Saturday 13 November from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday 14 November from 1 p.m. to 7 p.m.<ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Francis K. Lalumiere wrote that an ECC sealed event drew 176 players, "the biggest tournament in Star Wars CCG history", ahead of the 152 at Origins constructed.<ref name="lal-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 November 1999 (Saturday heat); 14 November 1999 (Sunday heat)
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Enhanced Format Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 176 per Lalumiere;<ref name="lal-sat" /> 162<ref name="sat58" /> and "160+"<ref name="sat68" /> per Decipher photo captions

A score sheet is not preserved.

== Photographs ==
Decipher's Saturday photo album shows the Enhanced Cloud City tournament. One caption places it in the 11th-floor lounge, another in the Cavalier's penthouse lounge.<ref name="sat58">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat58.html DecipherCon 1999 photo sat58], Decipher. Caption: "The 11th floor lounge is a great setting for the 162! player Enhanced Cloud City tournament." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001025165217/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat58.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sat67">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat67.html DecipherCon 1999 photo sat67], Decipher. Caption: "The Enhanced Cloud City tournament draws players to the Cavalier's penthouse lounge." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000616071452/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat67.html Internet Archive]</ref>
